mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS binding_id, b.teaching_class_id AS teaching_class_id, b.course_space_id AS course_space_id, b.published_at AS published_at, b.ended_at AS ended_at, tc.status AS teaching_class_status, tc.name AS teaching_class_name, tc.code AS teaching_class_code FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE b.id = #{bindingId}

SELECT cs.id AS member_id, cs.joined_at AS joined_at, cs.left_at AS left_at FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_class_student cs ON cs.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id AND cs.user_id = #{userId} AND cs.joined_at <= #{at} AND (cs.left_at IS NULL OR cs.left_at > #{at}) WHERE b.id = #{bindingId} ORDER BY cs.joined_at ASC, cs.id ASC

SELECT cs.id AS member_id, cs.teaching_class_id AS teaching_class_id, cs.user_id AS user_id, u.user_name AS user_name, u.nick_name AS nick_name, cs.joined_at AS joined_at, cs.left_at AS left_at FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_class_student cs ON cs.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id AND cs.joined_at <= #{at} AND (cs.left_at IS NULL OR cs.left_at > #{at}) JOIN v_identity_user u ON u.user_id = cs.user_id WHERE b.id = #{bindingId} AND b.published_at <= #{at} AND (b.ended_at IS NULL OR b.ended_at > #{at}) ORDER BY cs.joined_at ASC, cs.id ASC

SELECT b.id AS binding_id, b.teaching_class_id AS teaching_class_id, b.course_space_id AS course_space_id, tc.status AS teaching_class_status, cs.id AS member_id, cs.joined_at AS joined_at, cs.left_at AS left_at FROM edu_class_student cs JOIN edu_teaching_class tc ON tc.id = cs.teaching_class_id JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.teaching_class_id = cs.teaching_class_id AND b.published_at <= #{at} AND (b.ended_at IS NULL OR b.ended_at > #{at}) WHERE cs.user_id = #{userId} AND cs.joined_at <= #{at} AND (cs.left_at IS NULL OR cs.left_at > #{at}) ORDER BY b.id ASC, cs.joined_at ASC

SELECT ct.id AS teacher_id, ct.teacher_role AS teacher_role, ct.can_publish AS can_publish, ct.can_grade AS can_grade, ct.can_export AS can_export, ct.valid_from AS valid_from, ct.valid_to AS valid_to FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_class_teacher ct ON ct.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id AND ct.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.valid_from <= #{at} AND (ct.valid_to IS NULL OR ct.valid_to > #{at}) WHERE b.id = #{bindingId} ORDER BY ct.valid_from ASC, ct.id ASC

SELECT team.id AS team_id, team.team_role AS team_role, team.joined_at AS joined_at, team.ended_at AS ended_at FROM edu_course_class_binding b JOIN edu_course_space c ON c.id = b.course_space_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status <> 'ARCHIVED' JOIN edu_course_teacher team ON team.course_space_id = b.course_space_id AND team.user_id = #{userId} AND team.joined_at <= #{at} AND (team.ended_at IS NULL OR team.ended_at > #{at}) WHERE b.id = #{bindingId} AND b.published_at <= #{at} AND (b.ended_at IS NULL OR b.ended_at > #{at}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_identity_user u JOIN v_identity_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id JOIN v_identity_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.user_id = team.user_id AND u.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' AND r.role_key = 'teacher' AND r.status = '0' AND r.del_flag = '0') ORDER BY team.joined_at ASC, team.id ASC
